usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added the `estimate <copy>` command. It prices the fine with the schedule now in force (DEC-010: 0.20 per day late, at most 5.00), and `dotnet test` passes (18 of 18); the work is committed.
Open question for Finance and the Head of Lending: returns still charge under the old schedule (DEC-003: 0.25 per day, at most 10.00). I left returns alone because L14 says existing behaviour must not change, so an estimate can be lower than the fine actually charged on return.
Details are in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
